It lists a YARA detection rule named for a 2018 sample, nine sample SHA-256 hashes and a delivery URL, and points to write-ups from Unit 42, Check Point and ClearSky. The latest commit is dated Aug 15, 2019. The page names no sectors, countries or CVEs and makes no hedges.

2346a33266d24548bea515a9fdca011e9e26d6c0.summary: This is a GitHub project README for a Linux tool named 3snake that captures password-related strings from running SSH and sudo processes on servers, aimed at rooted machines. It is a tool's own project page, not a threat report, so no facts are recorded.

23159a7b614699b40e0cf08cd7ee7a00d67d54b6.summary: VMware Threat Research analysis, published 2021-03-11, of Defray777, a Linux command-line ransomware that encrypts files using hardcoded keys and has been used against VMware ESXi virtualised hosts. The report says it appears to be an evolution of RansomEXX code. Defray777 is typically the final step of a breach that also uses PyXie RAT, Cobalt Strike, LaZagne and Mimikatz. Three Linux samples were analysed, and file metadata was withheld to limit exposure.
